title: Apartments.com Scraper Input
description: Find Apartments.com rentals by city or ZIP, paste property URLs, or look up listing keys. Filters and extra detail are optional.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How to find listings: `search` uses a city or ZIP plus filters; `urls` uses the Apartments.com URLs you paste; `listingKeys` looks up the listing keys you paste.

searchLocation.title: Search location
searchLocation.description: US city and state (`New York, NY`) or 5-digit ZIP (`10001`). Used only in search mode.
searchLocation.sectionDescription: Narrow the search by rent, size, type, pets and amenities. All filters are optional.

bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Match listings with at least one floor plan of this bedroom count.

bathrooms.title: Bathrooms
bathrooms.description: Match listings with a floor plan at or above this bathroom count.

priceMin.title: Minimum monthly rent ($)
priceMin.description: Lowest monthly rent to include. Leave unset for no minimum.

priceMax.title: Maximum monthly rent ($)
priceMax.description: Highest monthly rent to include. Leave unset for no maximum.

sqftMin.title: Minimum square feet
sqftMin.description: Smallest floor plan to include. Leave unset for no minimum.

sqftMax.title: Maximum square feet
sqftMax.description: Largest floor plan to include. Leave unset for no maximum.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Restrict results to one property type.

petPolicy.title: Pet policy
petPolicy.description: Require listings that allow dogs, cats, or both.

amenities.title: Required amenities
amenities.description: Only return listings that publish every selected amenity.

rentSpecials.title: Rent specials only
rentSpecials.description: Only return listings advertising a current move-in deal.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only return listings rated at or above this score (1–5).

moveInDate.title: Move-in by date
moveInDate.description: Only return listings with a unit available on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

specialties.title: Lifestyle / housing type
specialties.description: Return listings matching at least one selected lifestyle or housing program. Student and senior housing are the most consistently published; other values are applied when the source exposes them.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep listings whose name, description, amenities, neighborhood or floor-plan names contain this text. Requires scrapeDetails=true.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Apartments.com city-search or property URLs. Used only in `urls` mode. A listing key is also accepted.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Paste URLs or listing keys instead of searching.

listingKeys.title: Listing keys
listingKeys.description: Apartments.com listing keys such as `d3pj6rk`. Used only in `listingKeys` mode.

maximizeCoverage.title: Maximize coverage
maximizeCoverage.description: When the public listing index cannot fill your request, automatically try the site's search page as a last resort. Off by default.

scrapeDetails.title: Fetch full details
scrapeDetails.description: Fetch floor plans, available units, fees, pets, parking, schools, office hours, manager, website and photos for each listing. Turn off for faster card-level results.

maxItems.title: Max listings
maxItems.description: Maximum listings to return (1–5,000). Search mode also stops at the maxPages scan depth.

maxPages.title: Max search depth (pages)
maxPages.description: How many 40-listing discovery pages to scan in search mode (1–20). Raise it when filters are narrow.
